ui.noaccess_role_what: Your role “{role}” has no access to the “{what}” section.
ui.noaccess_what: Your role has no access to the “{what}” section.
ui.noaccess_ask: Ask the site administrator: they can give you another role in Settings → Users.
ui.readonly_note: View only: your role cannot edit {what}. You can look, but not change.
ui.conflict_page: The page was changed while it was open
ui.conflict_item: The record was changed while it was open
ui.conflict_table: The table was changed while it was open
ui.conflict_unsaved: Your edits are not saved yet. Autosave is paused.
ui.tree_gone_moved: Could not find what you are moving: reload the page
ui.tree_gone_target: Could not find where you are moving it: reload the page
ui.tree_into_self: An item cannot be nested inside itself
ui.tree_into_branch: An item cannot be nested inside its own branch
ui.tree_flat: There is no nesting here: everything sits on one level
ui.tree_too_deep: No more than {max} levels are allowed here
ui.tree_gone_pick: Could not find what to move: reload the page
ui.tree_first: Cannot go higher: this is the first position
ui.tree_last: Cannot go lower: this is the last position
ui.tree_no_sibling: Nothing to nest into: there is no item above
ui.tree_top_level: This is already the top level
ui.tree_at_top: “{name}”: at the top level, position {place} of {total}
ui.tree_home_first: This position is taken: the home page always comes first
ui.tree_grip_title: Drag, or press Alt + arrow keys
ui.tree_grip_label: Move: {name}. Alt and the arrows move it, Alt and the right arrow nests it, the left arrow moves it out
ui.kanban_back_title: Move to the column on the left (Alt + ←)
ui.kanban_next_title: Move to the column on the right (Alt + →)
ui.profile_role_help: The site administrator changes the role: Settings → Users.
ui.profile_err_email_typo: There seems to be a typo in the email address
ui.profile_password_hint: To change your password you will need the current one.

ui.profile_pw_too_short.one: The new password must be at least {count} character long
ui.profile_pw_too_short.other: The new password must be at least {count} characters long

ui.history_empty_page: Every edit of the page will appear here: who made it and when. Any version can be restored.
ui.history_empty_item: Every edit of the record will appear here: who made it and when. Any version can be restored.
ui.history_empty_settings: Every edit of the settings will appear here: who made it and when. Any version can be restored.
ui.history_empty_menu: Every edit of the menu will appear here: who made it and when. Any version can be restored.
ui.history_restore_msg_page: The draft of the page will go back to how it was as of {when}. What is on the site now will not change until you publish again. The current state will be kept in the history, so you can go back.
ui.history_restore_msg_item: The draft of the record will go back to how it was as of {when}. What is on the site now will not change until you publish again. The current state will be kept in the history, so you can go back.
ui.history_restore_msg_settings: The draft of the settings will go back to how it was as of {when}. What is on the site now will not change until you publish again. The current state will be kept in the history, so you can go back.
ui.history_restore_msg_menu: The draft of the menu will go back to how it was as of {when}. What is on the site now will not change until you publish again. The current state will be kept in the history, so you can go back.
ui.history_restored: Version restored. It is in the draft: it will reach the site after publishing
ui.history_restored_elsewhere: Draft restored. Select {lang} in this editor to open it.
ui.history_open_failed: Could not open the history entry
ui.history_baseline: This is how everything looked before the first edit in the history.
ui.history_in_trash: It can be restored from the trash.
ui.history_what_changes: What will change if you restore it

ui.history_against.one: {count} change in the draft. What is there now is struck through on the left.
ui.history_against.other: {count} changes in the draft. What is there now is struck through on the left.

ui.history_keep.one: Consecutive edits by one person are merged into one entry. {count} entry is kept, older ones are deleted.
ui.history_keep.other: Consecutive edits by one person are merged into one entry. {count} entries are kept, older ones are deleted.

ui.rd_not_sent: The request was not sent. A messenger is not connected, is turned off in settings, or no chat is set for the form
ui.rd_status_hint_edit: New requests are shown in bold and counted in the menu badge. Spam stays in the list but stays out of the way.
ui.rd_status_hint_view: Only people who may edit requests can change the status.
ui.rd_failed_lead: The message did not reach a messenger.
ui.rd_failed_text: The request is saved here, nothing is lost. Check the chat and send it again.
ui.rd_note_placeholder: For example: called back, agreed on Friday
ui.rd_note_hint: The customer will not see it. Only staff can.
ui.today_none_text: There is nothing here for your role yet. The sections open to you are in the menu on the left.
ui.today_waiting_empty: Nothing is waiting for publication right now. When an author sends a page or record for publication, it will appear here.
ui.today_requests_empty: No new requests. When a customer leaves a request on the site, it will appear here.
ui.today_failed_hint: The requests are saved in the “Requests” section, and can be sent again
ui.today_unpublished_empty: Everything is published: the site shows the latest version.
ui.today_recent_empty: Nothing has been published yet. The latest publications will appear here.
ui.trash_sub: Deleted pages and records. Any of them can be restored: it will appear in the drafts and reach the site after publishing. After a year the trash is emptied.
ui.trash_restored: “{title}” was restored. It is in the drafts: it will reach the site after publishing
ui.trash_was_live_hint: It was published before deletion. After restoring, publish it again
ui.trash_not_restorable: It cannot be restored: the template or section no longer exists on the site
ui.trash_empty_text: Deleted pages and records will appear here.
ui.rq_sub: Everything visitors sent through the site forms. The message also goes to the messengers (Telegram, MAX). Here you can see whether it arrived.
ui.rq_locale_label: Site language the request came from
ui.rq_bad_range: The “from” date is later than the “to” date — there are no requests for such a period. Swap the dates.
ui.rq_spam_hidden: Spam is hidden from the board: {count}. To see it, use the “Spam” filter in the table.
ui.rq_empty_filtered_text: The filters may have narrowed the choice too much. Reset them to see all requests.
ui.rq_empty_text: When a visitor leaves a phone number in a form on the site, the request will appear here and be sent to the messengers.
ui.ym_intro: Connect Webmaster to see the site's quality index (ИКС), pages in Yandex search, site problems and the queries people find it by.
ui.ym_ask_admin: Ask an administrator to connect Webmaster.
ui.ym_ask_admin_renew: Ask an administrator to paste a new token.
ui.ym_token_help: Open the link, allow access and paste the token from the address bar. It is valid for 6 months and we will remind you to renew it.
ui.ym_no_client: To get a token you need an app in Yandex OAuth with the scopes webmaster:hostinfo and webmaster:verify.
ui.ym_disconnect_message: The token is deleted from the CMS and the numbers leave the screen. The site stays in Webmaster, and you can connect it again at any time.
ui.ym_load_failed: Could not load Yandex Webmaster data
ui.ym_token_expiring: The Yandex token is valid until {date}. Paste a new one so the data does not stop.
ui.ym_token_expired: The Yandex token expired on {date}. Paste a new one so the data updates again.
ui.ym_token_invalid: Yandex does not accept the saved token. Paste a new one.
ui.ym_no_address: Yandex Webmaster needs a public site address. Set it in Settings → Site → address.
ui.ym_no_http_client: The package symfony/http-client is not installed on the server, so the CMS cannot reach Yandex. Pass this to the site developer.
ui.ym_verifying: Yandex is verifying ownership of the site. The numbers appear after the check, usually within a few minutes.
ui.ym_verification_failed: Yandex did not confirm ownership of the site
ui.ym_reason_meta_tag_not_found: Yandex did not find the meta tag on the home page. Check that the home page opens without a password and contains the tag.
ui.ym_reason_unknown: Yandex gave no reason. Press Refresh to run the check again.
ui.ym_collecting: Yandex is still collecting data about the site. It appears within a few days.
ui.profile_unsaved: Your name or email changes have not been saved. Closing the profile will discard them.
